text:
sam: starting staged rollout redwood/v2.4.1 -> ap-south at 5% for 7m. changewindow 04:00-05:00 UTC. watch p95 and errors.
DeployBot: rollout started by sam: redwood/v2.4.1 fraction=5% region=ap-south window=7m
ali: yup noted. are we pinning the runtime to avoid autoswap?
margo: yes pin the canary: /deploy pin redwood/v2.4.1@ap-south. QA passed smoke tests but keep an eye on cold-starts.
DeployBot: 5% traffic routed, health checks OK @ t+45s
qa-bot: running canary probe set A: latency p95 within baseline, no regressions detected
ops-bot: alerting thresholds set: p95 +30% or 5xx >0.5%
ali: seeing a few 504s on edge-7, small tail. not at threshold yet.
sam: hold if 5xx>0.5% or p95>30%. otherwise continue to 10% after window.
DeployBot: health event: ap-south: p95 increased 36% over baseline for 2m -> auto-pause engaged. traffic -> 0%
margo: confirmed pause. grabbing logs and traces. command: `rb logs deploy=redwood/v2.4.1 --since=10m`
ali: traces show increased kernel fallback for batcher when qlen >8. looks like batching heuristic mismatch with new kernel.
sam: decision: roll back canary to stable and open a kernel-tuning follow-up. + pin revert.
DeployBot: rollback executed by sam: revert redwood/v2.4.1 -> redwood/v2.4.0-stable; pin removed for canary
qa-bot: post-rollback probes green after 6m. no OOMs or 5xx.
margo: follow-ups: (1) add kernel-selection sanity check in preflight (2) add small-memory canary with the new kernel disabled (3) update release notes saying rollback reason.
sam: thanks everyone. will file the tickets and re-run canary after kernel tweak. DeployBot: thread closed by sam.
